title: Style and coding rules
summary: Coding conventions and git habits, plus a PR description format. Loaded every session.
details: This rule loads in every session and sets how Claude writes code: the smallest change that solves the request, in the existing style of the project. It also sets git habits: never putting a Claude session link in commits or PRs, and PR descriptions with a plain-words part first and a short part for the reviewer, held in a small pr-description skill. It is a text file in your rules folder plus one skill folder; no code runs and no network is used.
risk: Text only, loaded into every session. No code runs.
